title: Airoran language
description: Foja Range language spoken in Indonesia
extract: Airoran is a language of Indonesia, spoken in the north coast area on the lower Apauwar River of Papua, in the villages of Subu, Motobiak, Isirania, etc. It is rather divergent from other Kwerba languages, though clearly related.
